responsibility: Implements the generic SSA propagation engine and value-replacement helpers used by multiple tree-SSA passes. It manages CFG and SSA-edge worklists over executable edges and simulated statements/PHIs, drives callback-based propagation to a fixed point, provides safe const/copy propagation and expression replacement routines for statements and operands, and includes cleanup helpers such as degenerate loop-closed-PHI propagation that simplify SSA once transformations expose trivial replacements.
same_name_distinction: Implements the generic SSA propagation engine and concrete replacement helpers, managing CFG/SSA worklists, simulation, and cleanup like loop-closed-PHI propagation. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-propagate.h, it provides the engine behavior rather than the API definitions, enums, and abstract callback class declarations.
